text:
Maya: Heads-up: planning Q3 runtime priorities — need to lock down scope by EOD Friday. Customers pushing for lower p95 and better throughput. Proposing a primary focus: KV cache consistency + quantization pipeline. Thoughts?

Jamal: Agree on KV cache improvements for chat-heavy apps. Customer 'CoreAI' reported 30% extra tokens from cache misses.

Sophie: Can we quantify target? e.g., reduce cache miss rate from 12% -> 3% on typical chat workloads? Also where does kernel work fit—do we need new fused-attn kernels in the same quarter?

Alex: Prefer split: M1 = KV cache reliability + continuous batching improvements; M2 = new kernels + int8 perf (since int8 requires eval/QA).

Priya: Customer asks: require p95 < 200ms on gen-small models at batch=4, seq=256. That's a hard SLA for Dedicated customers.

Maya: OKR proposal: throughput +30% at p95 baseline, cache miss <= 5%, quantization path (int8) reduces cost per token by 40% vs fp16 in perf env. We need launch criteria.

Jamal: Suggested launch criteria list: 1) Benchmark harness results vs baseline 2) Regression tests across 5 model families 3) Canary rollout with fallback policy 4) Docs + SDK examples.

Sophie: Also add: end-to-end latency breakdown per token in console and a tracer for KV miss hotspots.

Alex: Tradeoffs: shipping kernels early might regress accuracy for some models. Need evals and rollback gates. Can we scope 'kernel v1' as opt-in (experimental) in M1?

Priya: For quant, require quality guardrails: perplexity delta < 1% on eval set, and hallucination rate measured via suite < 0.5%.

Victor: I'll own perf harness and will add tests. Draft command for reproducible run:

```
make bench MODEL=gpt3a BATCH=4 SEQ=256 RUNS=100
# collects p50 p95 tokens/s mem usage
```

infra-bot: Deploy bot: scheduled canary window on prod-cluster-2 for 2025-06-10 02:00-04:00 UTC

Maya: Scope negotiation: prioritize KV cache + batching + perf harness. Quantization and kernels as gated M2 items unless a high-value customer commits.

Jamal: Customer commit possibility: CoreAI sign-up for Dedicated if we deliver p95 SLA; could accelerate budget. Recommend sales sync.

Priya: I'll draft OKR wording and add measurement dashboard metrics. Ping me if you have baseline numbers.

Maya: :thumbsup: Let's sync tomorrow 9am to finalize. Action items: Victor owns harness, Jamal to coordinate customer asks, Sophie to draft kernel opt-in UX, Alex for rollout policy
